entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A 25,000-year-old dragon planeswalker and extraordinary schemer who poses a greater threat to the Multiverse than almost any other creature alive.

events.summary: Bolas's machinations touch countless planes, with plots that sometimes lie dormant for decades before coming to fruition.
events.quote: the seeds of his elaborate plots sometimes lie dormant for decades before they come to fruition.
